import os,json,subprocess,shlex,tomllib,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1'
h=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']['termux-phone']
key=Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser(); known=root/'adb_usb_known_hosts'
assert known.is_file() and key.is_file() and (root/'data/app.db').is_file()
usb=[r.split()[0] for r in subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25).stdout.splitlines()[1:] if len(r.split())>1 and r.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in r.split()[0]]
assert len(usb)==1
serial=usb[0];port='18122'
ssh=['ssh','-i',str(key),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UserKnownHostsFile='+str(known),'-o','ConnectTimeout=12','-o','ServerAliveInterval=20','-o','ServerAliveCountMax=10','-p',port,str(h['user'])+'@127.0.0.1']
f=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,'forward','tcp:'+port,'tcp:8022'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
assert f.returncode==0,f.stderr
print('USB_FORWARD_PASS',flush=True)
def remote(script,timeout=60):
 return subprocess.run(ssh+['bash -c '+shlex.quote(script)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
try:
 check=r'''set -eu
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux/import-pi-20261101-v1"
test -d "$D/data" && test -f "$D/data/app.db"
test -d "$D/storage/private" && test -d "$D/storage/public"
test ! -L "$D" && test ! -L "$D/storage/private" && test ! -L "$D/storage/public"
printf 'STAGE_KIB='; du -sk "$D"|cut -f1
printf 'PHOTO_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 6 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8010/health
printf 'ILESTOI_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 6 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready
'''
 before=remote(check)
 print('USB_PHONE_PREFLIGHT='+json.dumps({'exit':before.returncode,'out':before.stdout[-1000:],'err':before.stderr[-500:]}),flush=True)
 assert before.returncode==0 and 'PHOTO_HTTP=200' in before.stdout and 'ILESTOI_HTTP=200' in before.stdout
 expected={}
 for kind in ('private','public'):
  d=root/'storage'/kind
  assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in d.rglob('*'))
  files=[p for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
  assert len(files)==1098,(kind,len(files))
  expected[kind]={'count':len(files),'bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files)}
 print('EXPECTED='+json.dumps(expected),flush=True)
 extract=r'''set -eu
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux/import-pi-20261101-v1"
cd "$D"
tar -xf -
echo 'TERMUX_TAR_EXTRACT_DONE'
'''
 env=dict(os.environ);env['COPYFILE_DISABLE']='1'
 t=time.monotonic()
 sender=subprocess.Popen(['tar','-C',str(root),'-cf','-','storage/private','storage/public'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env)
 try:receiver=subprocess.run(ssh+['bash -c '+shlex.quote(extract)],stdin=sender.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5900)
 finally:sender.stdout.close()
 err=sender.stderr.read().decode(errors='replace')[-900:]
 sr=sender.wait(timeout=90)
 print('USB_TRANSFER='+json.dumps({'elapsed_s':round(time.monotonic()-t,1),'mac_exit':sr,'phone_exit':receiver.returncode,'phone_out':receiver.stdout[-600:],'phone_err':receiver.stderr[-700:],'mac_err':err},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 assert sr==0 and receiver.returncode==0,'USB tar stream incomplete'
 verify=r'''set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PYVERIFY'
import hashlib,json,sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
d=Path.home()/'Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux/import-pi-20261101-v1'
b=d/'data/app.db'
with sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(b)+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as c:
 assert c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
 assert c.execute('pragma foreign_key_check').fetchall()==[]
z={}
for k in ('private','public'):
 files=[p for p in (d/'storage'/k).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()]
 z[k]={'count':len(files),'bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files)}
print('PHONE_STAGE='+json.dumps({'db_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'media':z}),flush=True)
PYVERIFY
printf 'PHOTO_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 7 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8010/health
printf 'ILESTOI_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 7 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready
'''
 done=remote(verify,220)
 print('USB_STAGE_VERIFY='+json.dumps({'exit':done.returncode,'out':done.stdout[-2800:],'err':done.stderr[-900:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 assert done.returncode==0
 result=json.loads([s.removeprefix('PHONE_STAGE=') for s in done.stdout.splitlines() if s.startswith('PHONE_STAGE=')][-1])
 assert result['db_sha256']=='24814f4084ef6989e4e7966d77d9f7cf88f033cd619d8c37eb66516adf3f3ede'
 assert result['media']==expected
 assert 'PHOTO_HTTP=200' in done.stdout and 'ILESTOI_HTTP=200' in done.stdout
 print('USB_TAR_MEDIA_FULL_SIZE_COUNT_AND_DB_PASS',flush=True)
finally:
 subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,'forward','--remove','tcp:'+port],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
